Buy a Canadian Passport on Telegram

The Canadian passport is issued by the IRCC passport programme. Every real one carries marks from that office and a seller who cannot point to them is guessing. This page is a checklist for that conversation.

Document type
A passport is the travel document a state issues to its own nationals. It is the only document on this site that proves nationality rather than residence or entitlement.

buy canadian passport on telegram – the short version

Nothing about Telegram makes a Canadian passport more likely to be fake. It is a shop window with no returns policy, which is why the checks matter more here than they would at a counter.

Everything here assumes the seller is a stranger and the money is not reversible. That is the normal condition on Telegram and it is why the process later on is staged rather than a single transfer.

Buy a Passport via Telegram: how the transaction works

Delivery is where most Canadian passport deals go quiet. Insist on a tracking number inside forty eight hours and treat a seller who only offers a photo of an envelope as unproven.

Do not send the balance against a promise of a tracking number. Send it against the number itself, checked on the carrier site rather than on a screenshot.

Who actually issues a Passport

Every feature on a Canadian passport exists because the IRCC passport programme put it there: substrate, print method, UV ink, number format. Strip those out and what is left is a picture of a card.

Finally, remember the office never contacts you. Any message claiming to be from the IRCC passport programme confirming your purchase is a second party, usually the seller, and worth exactly as much as their word.

Replica or registered original

The middle tier is stock. The seller has real blank or cancelled stock of the right type and prints onto it, so the physical layer is genuine and the number is invented. Most adverts at the middle of the band are this.

Some sellers will not send a number before a deposit. That is a reasonable position, but the deposit should be small and the number should follow immediately after it.

What a fair price looks like

Prices move with the document own difficulty. A card with a chip and a UV layer costs more to produce than a laminate print and the advert should reflect that.

Replacement terms are the other hidden line. A seller who replaces a failed parcel prices higher and is usually worth the premium, but only after a track record long enough to make the promise mean something.

The buying process, step by step

Work through these in order. Each step exists because it is where a bad Canadian passport deal usually breaks.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the IRCC passport programme.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the IRCC passport programme uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 170–600 CAD band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

The five checks below take minutes and catch almost everything. Two of them are specific to Canada.

  • Confirm the province is spelled and abbreviated correctly and that the card carries a provincial crest rather than a federal one.
  • Check the passport for maple leaf perforations and the raised intaglio feel of the coat of arms.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the IRCC passport programme. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • A passport data page with the place of birth written in American state format.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What should a passport cost on Telegram?

Between 180 and 900 US dollars depending on whether you are buying a print, correct stock, or a number that resolves at the issuing office.

Is a Telegram passport genuine?

Usually not. Most adverts sell a replica or a registered original, and the two are priced very differently. Ask which one it is in writing.

How long does delivery take?

Adverts quote anything from same day to four weeks. A tracked number that moves inside 48 hours is the realistic standard.

Can a passport number be checked?

Only against the issuing office register or an airline check-in system. A seller who offers no route to a register check is selling a print.

What is the most common fake?

A colour photocopy of a real data page laminated into a blank cover with a plausible number typed in.

Before you pay

If you have a Canadian passport in front of you and something feels off, compare it against the list above before you send anything.
